category_title: Passive classroom bystanders who engage through personal narratives and experimental design
scenario_title: Group investigation with dismissed authentic study design
minimal_context: The student is participating in a freshman biology group investigation to test environmental impacts on plants.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's review your group's plan for testing environmental impacts on the plants.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I tried to give suggestions for a more authentic study design. In middle school science classes, we did real hands-on experiments, but here they just want to pour Windex on the plants.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What did your group members say when you shared your idea?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: My suggestions were dismissed by my classmates.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Well, try to keep participating and working with your group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes a silent bystander, limiting her interactions and just watching as the group members talk about pouring the Windex.)
